```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(fixest)
library(lubridate)
library(modelsummary)
library(stargazer)
library(countrycode)
``` 

```{r load_data}
# Load BTS data
data_2016 <- read.csv("T_T100I_MARKET_ALL_CARRIER.csv")
data_2017 <- read.csv("T_T100I_MARKET_ALL_CARRIER 2.csv")
data_2018 <- read.csv("T_T100I_MARKET_ALL_CARRIER 3.csv")
data_2019 <- read.csv("T_T100I_MARKET_ALL_CARRIER 4.csv")
data_2020 <- read.csv("T_T100I_MARKET_ALL_CARRIER 5.csv") %>%
  filter(MONTH < 3)
combined_data <- bind_rows(data_2016, data_2017, data_2018, data_2019, data_2020)

# Load Gravity data
gravity_data <- read.csv("Gravity_csv_V202211/Gravity_V202211.csv") |>
  filter(year >= 2016 & year <= 2020)
``` 

```{r iso_mapping}
iso_mapping <- tibble(
  ISO3 = countrycode::codelist$iso3c,
  COUNTRY_NAME = countrycode::codelist$country.name.en
)
``` 

```{r clean_data}
# Clean BTS and define country pairs
bts_clean <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    ROUTE = paste(ORIGIN_COUNTRY_NAME, DEST_COUNTRY_NAME, sep = "-"),
    ROUTE_REVERSED = paste(DEST_COUNTRY_NAME, ORIGIN_COUNTRY_NAME, sep = "-"),
    COUNTRY_PAIR = pmin(ROUTE, ROUTE_REVERSED),
    YearMonth = as.Date(paste(YEAR, MONTH, "01", sep = "-"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(COUNTRY_PAIR, YearMonth) %>%
  summarise(PASSENGERS = sum(PASSENGERS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(BRAZIL_ROUTE = ifelse(COUNTRY_PAIR == "Brazil-United States", 1, 0))
``` 

```{r filter_model_data}
bts_model <- bts_clean %>%
  filter(YearMonth <= as.Date("2020-02-01")) %>%
  mutate(
    POST_2018 = ifelse(YearMonth >= as.Date("2018-04-01"), 1, 0),
    ln_PASSENGERS = log1p(PASSENGERS),
    TREAT = BRAZIL_ROUTE * POST_2018,
    BRAZIL_RECESSION = ifelse(BRAZIL_ROUTE == 1 & YearMonth %in% seq(as.Date("2019-08-01"), as.Date("2019-12-01"), by = "1 month"), 1, 0),
    TREAT_RECESSION = BRAZIL_ROUTE * BRAZIL_RECESSION
  )
``` 

```{r merge_gravity}
# Gravity data with explicit US identification
gravity_named <- gravity_data %>%
  left_join(iso_mapping, by = c("iso3_o" = "ISO3")) %>%
  rename(FOREIGN_COUNTRY = COUNTRY_NAME) %>%
  filter(iso3_d == "USA") %>%
  select(year, FOREIGN_COUNTRY, gdp_o, pop_o)

# Join with BTS model
bts_model <- bts_model %>%
  mutate(
    FOREIGN_COUNTRY = str_replace(COUNTRY_PAIR, "United States-", ""),
    FOREIGN_COUNTRY = str_replace(FOREIGN_COUNTRY, "-United States", ""),
    YEAR = year(YearMonth)
  ) %>%
  left_join(gravity_named, by = c("FOREIGN_COUNTRY", "YEAR" = "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    ln_gdp_foreign = log1p(gdp_o),
    ln_pop_foreign = log1p(pop_o)
  )
``` 

```{r run_did_updated}
did_model_with_gravity <- feols(
  ln_PASSENGERS ~ TREAT + TREAT_RECESSION + ln_gdp_foreign + ln_pop_foreign | COUNTRY_PAIR + YearMonth,
  data = bts_model,
  cluster = ~COUNTRY_PAIR
)
summary(did_model_with_gravity)
``` 

```{r plot_averages}
# Step 1: Calculate group averages
plot_data <- bts_model %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(BRAZIL_ROUTE == 1, "US–Brazil", "Other US–Foreign")) %>%
  group_by(Group, YearMonth) %>%
  summarise(AVG_PASSENGERS = mean(PASSENGERS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: Normalize to March 2018 = 100
plot_data_normalized <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(
    BASE = AVG_PASSENGERS[YearMonth == as.Date("2018-03-01")],
    INDEXED_PASSENGERS = (AVG_PASSENGERS / BASE) * 100
  )

# Step 3: Plot
ggplot(plot_data_normalized, aes(x = YearMonth, y = INDEXED_PASSENGERS, color = Group)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.7, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2018-03-01"), color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2019-08-01"),  color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Passenger Volumes: US–Brazil vs. US–Foreign Routes",
    x = "Month", 
    y = "Index (March 2018 = 100)",
    caption = "Dashed = Policy (2018), Red = Brazil Recession (Aug 2019)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkorange","darkgreen"))
ggsave("us-brazil updates.png")
```

```{r model_summary}
res<- modelsummary(
  list("Log(Passengers) Specification" = did_model_with_gravity),
  output = "latex", 
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
  statistic = "({std.error})",
  stars = c("*" = 0.1, "**" = 0.05, "***" = 0.01),
  title = "Difference-in-Differences: Log Passenger Volumes with Gravity Controls",
  gof_omit = "IC|Log|Adj|AIC|BIC"
)
res
```
